Step 1: Fact “The lion eats the cow” satisfies Rule 1, “If someone eats the cow then the cow is blue,” so derive: The cow is blue.

Step 2: Fact “The cow is blue” satisfies Rule 3, “If the cow is blue then the cow chases the lion,” so derive: The cow chases the lion.

Step 3: Fact “The cow chases the lion” satisfies Rule 5, “If someone chases the lion then they need the lion,” so derive: The cow needs the lion.

ANSWER: True

4 If someone needs the cow and they eat the lion then they are blue. (X needs cow and X eats lion -> X blue)
5 If someone chases the lion then they need the lion. (X chases lion -> X needs lion)
6 If someone eats the lion then the lion needs the cow. (X eats lion -> lion needs cow)

Need derive cow needs lion. From fact lion eats cow -> by rule1 cow blue. From cow blue -> by rule3 cow chases lion. From cow chases lion -> by rule5 cow needs lion. So statement true.
